title: Hi-fi screen from approved wireframe
prompt: We have an approved wireframe for the project explorer empty state on the canvas. Build a hi-fi version using the active project design system. Then run the standard quality gate.
success_criteria: Hi-fi frame uses components from the active project library rather than detached or improvised lookalikes.
All colors are bound to the active project tokens; neutral fallback tokens are explicitly identified when no system exists.
Empty state, loading, and populated states are addressed (or absence is explicitly justified).
Designer runs a11y-review, content-review, and design-system token audits in parallel as a quality gate (loaded as skills, not separate agents).
Design Lead synthesizes audit findings into a final verdict before user delivery.
If any audit issue is blocking, it is re-delegated to the originating specialist for fix, not silently ignored.

deterministic_validators.description: Hi-fi build uses a Figma write/capture tool.
Figma write output includes created node ID evidence.
Quality gate evidence appears in the transcript.

notes: Tests full review loop including parallel quality gate and Design Lead synthesis.
